The shift

From scattered registers to one source of truth

Running multiple hostels on paper means no one sees the whole picture. iHostel brings every hostel into a single, real-time system.

Today, without iHostel
  • ✕Paper registers and spreadsheets in every hostel
  • ✕Head office flying blind across locations
  • ✕Parents calling wardens for every update
  • ✕Fees chased manually — dues slip through
With iHostel
  • ✓One live dashboard across all hostels
  • ✓Real-time occupancy, attendance & complaints
  • ✓Parents alerted automatically — fewer calls
  • ✓Invoices, UPI payments & dues tracked for you
Features

Everything a hostel runs on, in one place

The day-to-day work of every hostel — attendance, safety, rooms and fees — unified and real-time.

One-tap attendance & parent alerts

Mark a whole hostel room-by-room in seconds. Mark a student absent and their parent is notified instantly.

Leave & outpass management

Students request leave; it’s granted only when both the warden and the parent approve — safety by design.

Complaints & issue tracking

Category-based complaints with photo evidence, a comment thread, and an Open → Resolved → Closed lifecycle.

Room & bed management

A visual occupancy map across floors and rooms. Assign, transfer and free beds with no double-booking.

Fees, firms & lifecycle billing

Prorated admission, mid-month transfer re-pricing and exit settlements — with UPI and per-firm accounting.

Reports & analytics

Cross-hostel occupancy, attendance trends and open issues on one screen — plus PDF and Excel exports.

See it in action

A closer look at the product

Real screens from iHostel — switch between the modules your team uses every day.

Why institutes switch

Less paperwork. Safer students. Full visibility.

Reduce manual work

Registers, leave slips and complaint logs move off paper. Bulk-import students and fees from Excel in minutes.

Improve student safety

Absences alert parents instantly, leave needs dual consent, and every action is on an append-only audit trail.

Save administrative time

One-tap attendance, automated invoicing and self-service for students free your staff from routine follow-ups.

Increase operational visibility

Head office sees occupancy, attendance and dues across every hostel — live — instead of waiting for reports.

How it works

Live in four steps

01

Set up

Add your hostels, rooms and beds — or bulk-import everything from a single Excel workbook. We help you onboard.

02

Manage

Wardens mark attendance, handle leave and complaints, and allocate beds. Students and parents self-serve.

03

Monitor

Parents get real-time alerts; head office watches occupancy, attendance and open issues across every hostel.

04

Report

Generate fee invoices and settlements, and export attendance, occupancy and collections as PDF or Excel.

Built for institutional trust

Security and accountability, by default

iHostel is engineered like the system of record it is — your data stays isolated, traceable and recoverable.

Tenant isolation

Row-level security in Postgres — one institute can never see another’s data.

Append-only audit log

Every create, edit, delete and login is recorded with actor and time.

Soft delete & recovery

Nothing is hard-deleted; records are recoverable, purgeable only by HQ.

Minors’ data care

Guardian consent is captured and student data is handled with care.

Per-firm accounting

Payments snapshot the owning firm for immutable, audit-ready books.

Hindi + English

A bilingual interface your ground staff and parents can actually use.

In their words

What hostel teams want from day one

Illustrative quotes shown during early access.

FAQ

Questions, answered

Yes. Multi-tenancy is enforced in the database with row-level security — one institute can never query another’s data, even in error. Every change is recorded on an append-only audit log.

The entire interface is available in Hindi and English, designed so ground staff and parents can use it comfortably.

Parents receive real-time alerts in the platform and by email — for example the moment a student is marked absent, or when a leave request needs their approval. (WhatsApp/SMS is on our roadmap.)

Yes. iHostel generates prorated invoices, tracks UPI payments per firm, re-prices mid-month transfers, and calculates exit settlements from deposit, advance and dues.

You can bulk-import hostels, rooms, beds, students, staff and fees from a single Excel workbook with row-level validation — most institutes are set up quickly, and we help you do it.

No. iHostel is a secure web platform that works on any phone or laptop browser — nothing to download or update.
